stem: According to valence bond theory, which condition is essential for the formation of a covalent bond? (a) Orbitals must be fully filled (b) Orbitals must contain unpaired electrons (c) Orbitals must be of the same energy always (d) Orbitals must be vacant
answer: b Orbitals must contain unpaired electrons

Why does head-on overlap of atomic orbitals form a stronger bond than sidewise overlap? (a) It forms π-bond (b) It has minimum overlap region (c) It produces symmetrical electron density along internuclear axis (d) It leads to non-bonding interaction

stem: Antibonding molecular orbital is formed by: (a) addition of wave functions of atomic orbitals (b) subtraction of wave functions of atomic orbitals (c) multiplication of wave functions of atomic orbitals (d) none of these
